answer: Bind every agent seat to a silicon PUF challenge-response: at power-on, uncontrollable manufacturing variation in SRAM cells hardens into a fingerprint, much as groundwater carves a unique karst network no two caves ever share. A verifier shines a fixed challenge through it like light through a prism, reading a stable per-die spectrum the foundry itself cannot reproduce. Cloning the software copies only the surface, leaving a forged seat to flare and fade like a dying ember. So N agents cost N real chips.
